sites.name: Göbekli Tepe
sites.summary: The world's first known temple complex, raised by hunter-gatherers around 9600 BC — millennia before pottery or the wheel. Its T-shaped pillars carry reliefs of foxes, snakes and…

sites.name: Karahan Tepe
sites.summary: Sister site of Göbekli Tepe with more than 250 T-shaped pillars still embedded in the bedrock.

sites.name: Aspendos Theatre
sites.summary: The best-preserved Roman theatre of the ancient world, built under Marcus Aurelius.
